ariaLabel.description: Accessible label, which can be different from the primary label.

disabled.description: Disables both mouse and keyboard functionality, and updates the visual style of the Chip to appear disabled.

heading.description: Adds more prominent text to act as a heading. Will be displayed on the left with a | separator.

invalid.description: Changes Chip styling to inform the user of an issue.

label.description: The content of the chip. Will be displayed on the right if you include a heading.

onClick.description: Chip click callback using a standard event-first signature.

onClickValue.description:
Value-first click callback retained as an upgrade path for existing consumers.
@deprecated Prefer `onClick` with a closure over the value.

type.name: (value: string | number, ev: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement | HTMLDivElement, MouseEvent>) => void

onKeyDown.description: Callback. Called when you keydown on Chip. Ships the event, so you can get the key pushed.

role.description: The accessible role the Chip is fulfilling. Defaults to 'button'

tabIndex.description: Used for accessibility purpopses, specifically using the tab key as navigation.

testID.description: The testing id for the chip if necessary.

value.description: Will be passed to onClick, when the user clicks on this Chip.

variation.description: Button style variation. Does not affect functionality.
